content.short: Gitcoin is a decentralized funding platform for public goods that uses quadratic funding to empower communities.
content.description:
Gitcoin is the leading platform for funding public goods within the Ethereum ecosystem, using quadratic funding to support open-source software. This model ensures that projects with broad community support receive the most matching funds. Through its Grants Stack, Gitcoin provides a protocol-based system that allows any community to run decentralized funding rounds.

The platform also offers Gitcoin Passport, a proof-of-humanity tool that prevents Sybil attacks in governance. By fostering collaboration between builders and donors, Gitcoin has become a cornerstone of the decentralized world, driving innovation in community resource coordination.
